from collections import deque
import sys

def dinic4(nH,hadj,others,x,y,limit):
    if x==y:return limit
    n=nH+len(others)
    adj=[[] for _ in range(n)]
    to=[];cap=[]
    for u,d in enumerate(hadj):
        au=adj[u]
        for v,c in d.items():
            if c>0:
                if c>limit:c=limit
                e=len(to);au.append(e);to.append(v);cap.append(c)
                adj[v].append(e+1);to.append(u);cap.append(0)
    sbase=nH
    for i,(C,V) in enumerate(others):
        s=sbase+i
        e=len(to);c=C if C<limit else limit
        adj[x].append(e);to.append(s);cap.append(c)
        adj[s].append(e+1);to.append(x);cap.append(0)
        as_=adj[s]
        for v in V:
            e=len(to);as_.append(e);to.append(v);cap.append(limit)
            adj[v].append(e+1);to.append(s);cap.append(0)
    flow=0
    while flow<limit:
        level=[-1]*n;level[x]=0
        q=deque([x]);sy=-1
        while q:
            u=q.popleft();lu=level[u]
            if sy>=0 and lu>=sy:break
            nl=lu+1
            for e in adj[u]:
                if cap[e]>0:
                    v=to[e]
                    if level[v]<0:
                        level[v]=nl
                        if v==y:sy=nl
                        else:q.append(v)
        if sy<0:break
        it=[0]*n
        # iterative blocking flow
        while flow<limit:
            stack=[x];path=[];mins=[limit-flow]
            found=False
            while stack:
                u=stack[-1]
                if u==y:
                    f=mins[-1]
                    for e in path:
                        cap[e]-=f;cap[e^1]+=f
                    flow+=f
                    found=True
                    break
                au=adj[u];i=it[u];la=len(au);nl=level[u]+1
                while i<la:
                    e=au[i];v=to[e]
                    if cap[e]>0 and level[v]==nl:break
                    i+=1
                it[u]=i
                if i>=la:
                    level[u]=-1;stack.pop()
                    if path:path.pop()
                    if mins:mins.pop()
                    if stack:
                        it[stack[-1]]+=1
                    continue
                e=au[i];v=to[e]
                stack.append(v);path.append(e)
                c=cap[e];curmin=mins[-1]
                mins.append(c if c<curmin else curmin)
            if not found:break
    return flow
